stocks.impact_theory: Trial enrollment pause due to side effects in depression drug study triggers sharp selloff. Economic implications: delays in pipeline hurt biotech valuations amid high interest rates. Market psychology: fear of failure in high-risk sector amplifies selling. Historical parallels: similar to past pharma trial failures like 2022 biotech crash. Analogies: like a startup missing a key milestone or a sports team losing star player mid-season.

news_impact_analysis.reasoning: Immediate 27%+ drop confirmed; X posts and news highlight negative sentiment on clinical setback. Limited recovery expected short-term without positive data updates.

potential_profit_risks.long_position: High risk; wait for stabilization or positive trial news for rebound potential 15-30%
potential_profit_risks.short_position: Opportunities for 10-20% further downside if no quick resolution; cover on any positive catalysts
potential_profit_risks.key_risks: Binary event risk on clinical data; regulatory or partnership news could reverse trend rapidly

stocks.justification: Clear, immediate negative catalyst with high volume confirms strong bearish shift
